item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i6aHMdiDpuc

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入解析核心戰鬥機制：了解結合《山海經》神話、精準格擋、閃避與無縫雙武器切換的高速動作 Roguelite 玩法。
  • 生動揭示荒誕神話劇情：一窺大禹義子「羿」與遠古殘魂「玄龍」的契約，以及化身異獸、識破九頭蛇相柳偽裝的獨特序章故事。
  • 實用的配裝與流派策略指南：提供雙刀霸體流、跳背背刺流、蒸氣能量回血流等實戰配置解析，幫助玩家快速掌握戰鬥節奏與通關訣竅。

摘要

融合神話與高速動作的 Roguelite 冒險

創作者 Rice 介紹了一款將近年流行的精準格擋、完美閃避與《黑帝斯》式高速第三人稱戰鬥、局內構築相結合的動作遊戲。本作以《山海經》古代異獸為背景，不僅擁有獨特的雙武器系統，更融入了極具考驗的 Roguelite 隨機要素。無論是武器切換攻擊還是格擋反擊，都深度考驗玩家的反應力與戰鬥經驗，操作手感出色且具備極高耐玩度。

大禹治水神話與靈魂共生的序幕

故事圍繞著大禹治水的神話傳說展開。主角為大禹的義子「羿」，因義父失蹤而隻身前往不周山尋找，途中因善心搭救精怪卻反遭兇獸偷襲而瀕死。命懸一線之際，炎帝舊部「玄龍」的殘魂現身，雙方達成以肉身換取尋找大禹並拯救蒼生的契約。玄龍隨後將羿的靈魂置入附近的異獸體內使其重生，並在斬殺兇獸後識破由九頭蛇怪「相柳」偽裝的天帝，展開一場驚險對決。擊敗序章頭目後，羿抵達主殿大廳，在此可遇見義母女媧與經營商販的妹妹，並展開裝備鍛造與天賦升級。

無縫切換的武器系統與多元連招

遊戲戰鬥的核心亮點在於雙武器無縫切換系統，玩家無需手動停頓切換，透過按鍵配置即可流暢施展雙手武器的連續技。試玩版中開放了劍、雙刀與弓，每種武器皆具備獨特的切換突進技；例如劍的切換攻擊能直接躍至敵人背後觸發高額背刺增傷，而雙刀的「亂舞」則具備強悍的霸體效果。雖然遊戲支援精準格擋，但並非強制依賴，玩家可依自身節奏選擇近戰防反或以遠距離弓箭謹慎消耗。

裝備配置與元素流派的深度構築

遊戲的進階核心在於戰鬥前的裝備搭配與局內的隨機詞條（神器）構築。玩家入場前可攜帶飾品，例如提供蒸氣能量自動回復並與「護身之風」回血技能完美契合的「靈脈飾品」，能大幅提升探險過程中的生存續航力。在闖關爬塔期間，玩家還能獲取水、火、毒、雷等元素附魔與特殊動作詞條，例如賦予雙刀在霸體狀態下額外 40% 的減傷效果，或是將劍氣外放化為遠程劍波。這些豐富的隨機組合讓每場戰鬥的構建策略與操作體驗都充滿層次感與深度。

================================================

Hello there, I'm Rice, and welcome to. my channel. Imagine taking the popular. precision parries and perfect dodges of. recent years, blending them with the. high-speed, third-person combat and. build-crafting of Hades, and pairing it. all with ancient, bizarre beasts from. the Classic of Mountains and Seas. That. is the action game we’re introducing. today: Nine Sols. This is an action RPG. developed and published by Red Candle. Games. The mere announcement of the. trailer drew quite a lot of attention. from players—after all, a game. developed by Red Candle is truly a. novelty, and the demo felt surprisingly. good to play. The core dual-weapon. system in Nine Sols isn't just about. letting you swap between two weapons; it incorporates systems that encourage. their use. With its fast-paced,. third-person 3D action and roguelite. elements, every attack transition,. parry, and counter tests your reflexes,. skill, and combat experience. The. gameplay is well above average in every. aspect. Today, I’d like to recommend. everyone give it a try. Since it's free. and highly playable, I strongly. recommend it. The game revolves around. the myth of Yu the Great harnessing the. waters and the spirits of the Classic. of Mountains and Seas. I’ll keep it. simple: you start by controlling Yi,. the foster son of Yu the Great. Because. your foster father has gone missing and. you care for the people of the world,. you head alone to Mount Buzhou to find. him. On the road, you see a vicious. beast about to eat a wind-spirit. creature. As the protagonist, you. naturally save the creature. Seeing the. beast beg for mercy and act as if. it’s genuinely repentant moves you,. so you soften your heart and let it go,. forgetting that such beasts are. incapable of telling the truth. With. your life hanging by a thread, Xuan. Long, who served under the Yan Emperor,. was exiled after the battle between the. two clans and eventually met his end on. the battlefield. His shattered soul. gradually faded away over centuries of. despair, which is where the two of you. meet. Xuan Long offers to help with one. thing in exchange for your physical. body. You think, "Well, I'm dying. anyway, might as well make the trade. I’ll have him help find my foster. father, Yu, and save the common people.

while I'm at it—if I'm going to make. a deal, I'll go big." Yi’s soul. eventually coexists with Xuan Long's in. the body, until Yi slowly loses. consciousness. Later, moved by a sudden. sense of pity, Xuan Long tosses Yi’s. soul into the nearby wind-spirit. creature, and Yi is resurrected as an. extremely rare chicken. Xuanlong. casually killed a beast on Mount Buzhou. and sought out the Celestial Lord to. negotiate when he could return to work,. only to realize mid-conversation that. the Lord was actually Xiang Liu in. disguise—a nine-headed serpent. monster—leading to a thrilling boss. battle. After defeating the prologue. boss, we descended into the main hall,. where we can prepare our weapons,. accessories, and items, as well as. craft gear, purchase supplies, and. upgrade talents. I’m using her as the. cover image, so I have to mention her:. this is your godmother, Nüwa. She is. the mother of Qi, the king of the Xia. dynasty, and also the wife of Dayu, so. technically, you and Qi are godbrothers. . The cat next to her is her younger. sister, who runs a business. You can. buy items from her, and any illusory. treasures found while exploring the map. can be sold directly to her. The. game’s combat system is quite fun. We. start with the White Cloud Sword and. Mist Bow. The game offers five. different types of weapons—three. melee and two ranged—with the demo. currently featuring the sword, dual. blades, and the bow. You don't need to. manually switch weapons during combat; the XY buttons or left and right mouse. clicks correspond directly to your two. equipped weapons. Beyond basic attacks. with XY or follow-up attacks after. dodging, every weapon has its own. unique moveset, which expands as you. unlock more talents. No matter which. two weapons you pair together, there. are specific transition attacks for. swapping between them. I really like. the sword's swap attack because it lets. you jump directly behind the enemy. This is safer since enemy attacks are. directional, and some random talents. provide damage bonuses for backstabs,. making fights much faster. I mentioned. perfect parrying earlier, but it’s. not an essential mechanic you’re. forced to master. Every weapon has a. special martial art triggered by RB and.

LB, such as the sword's parry or the. dual blades '"Flurry," which has super. armor and deals high damage. When I. first started playing, I found it to be. a bit challenging. Generally,. rogue-lite action games don't have this. many moves or such a wide variety of. features; they usually focus the. randomness on skill builds. In this. game, there are so many moves available. from the start that it might take a few. extra runs to fully understand the. mechanics. Early on, I wasn't familiar. with enemy attack patterns or the. game's rhythm, so I chose to hack and. slash in melee while using parries. When I encountered situations I didn't. understand, I’d slowly pick them off. with my bow. I found this to be a very. effective learning strategy. Things. were going smoothly and I was pushing. through steadily, but I soon realized I. had underestimated the boss fights in*. Dinghai*. Let alone the bosses. currently available in the three seas,. even the elite boss fights while. climbing the tower aren't exactly easy. I felt that staying at a distance with. the bow went against my nature, and no. matter how I played it, I just couldn't. get it right. So, I switched to a. dual-blade setup, going in with X-Y-X-Y. combos, focusing on precision parries. and dodging, which felt much more. natural. In particular, the blade's " Sword Dance" move allows you to dodge. attacks while dealing high damage, and. the dash attack has great range and. strong hit detection. For encounters. needing a quick start, leading with a. dash attack is a simple, high-damage,. and low-cost opening. *Dinghai*has an. equipment system consisting of two. weapons, two accessories, and one piece. of clothing. I haven't seen any clothes. yet; they might be skins or a. mid-to-late game system. Your gear. affects your core gameplay and. playstyle. You can only equip two items. before entering a run, and you cannot. change them once you've started. For. example, the "Yoran Accessory" provides. one bar of steam energy and a boost to. skill damage, with a "Full Power" effect that increases damage by 25%when. your health is above 90%. I personally. prefer the "Spirit Vein Accessory" you. get at the start. It recovers one bar. of steam every 10 seconds during combat. . Since steam for skills doesn't.

regenerate automatically—and recovery. items on the map are random attributes. —it's a limited resource. Plus, I. like using the "Wind of Protection" skill, which costs two bars of steam. It deals damage in an area for six. seconds and restores 1%of your health. per second. Since I was taking damage. so often and getting tired of dying, I. figured if I recover one bar every 10. seconds, that means I can restore 6%of. my health every 20 seconds. If I need. to, I can just run in circles in a mob. room to stall for time while my energy. recovers. By playing it safe, I can. eventually manage to reach a boss with. full health. The equipment you bring in. determines your basic experience, even. though we might encounter many. different attribute choices as we climb. the tower. For example, the "Seeker" artifact lets you deal backstab damage. with all your attacks for 10 seconds. after a successful backstab. It works. great with the sword's jump attack,. which almost always triggers it. It’s. also very effective against bosses; since they’re so huge, it's easy to. hit their backs, and it can even imbue. your attacks with Frost, Fire, or. Lightning elements. There is a. significant amount of these attributes,. with plenty of choices and variety. Even if you play for five or six hours,. you’ll still encounter new options. These usually correspond to the. attributes of specific weapons. For. instance, the starting "White Mist. Sword" is Water-aligned, so artifacts. like "Cold Circle" or "Curse" are. triggered by it. If you get "Burning" or "Explosion," those are triggered by. the "Heaven-Burning Twin Blades." There. are even upgrades that change your. weapon's moveset, like turning sword. slashes into projectile sword beams. Since you equip your weapons before. entering the stage, the random. artifacts you find inside are also. tailored to your build. In the current. demo, you can already imagine several. viable builds. For example, the sword. and blade work well with water and fire. , while the Ebony Bow and Ebony Sword. both use poison, making them much more. synergistic when choosing your. artifacts. I find the selection process. quite fun because they use many. different ways to layer the gameplay. experience. While weapon movesets have.

some variety, they mainly fall into a. few types: basic combos, combo. finishers, charged heavy attacks,. exclusive weapon skills, and. weapon-swap attacks. The artifacts you. choose might target specific elemental. attacks. Or they might focus on a. specific elemental weapon or a. particular weapon-swap move; these. combinations make combat feel easier or. more satisfying. For example, I once. got a buff that grants 40%damage. reduction while in super armor; the. dual blade flurry becomes quite strong,. and since it now has damage reduction,. I use it much more often. These choices. make the combat flow much more. comfortably. I’ll start by showing a. clip of me playing an elite battle very. poorly. It feels a bit chaotic. I know. the boss only has those few moves, but. it lacks a sense of rhythm. Before you. fully grasp the patterns, it’s quite. a struggle and feels a bit difficult. The boss casts spells, runs away when. you try to close the distance, and. periodically releases suicide bugs to. harass you. There are also two annoying. mosquitoes in the distance that allow. you to perform parries. The boss design. is actually quite decent. The boss. battle in the demo actually performs. quite well with solid combat mechanics. and good impact. At first, I didn't. know why I couldn't land any parries,. but later, I don't know why, but I. could suddenly do them all. Actually, I. initially felt the hit detection wasn't. great, but now I think it’s pretty. solid. The combat isn't exactly simple; most bosses have a clear P2, and. possibly a P3. They might not always. have an obvious phase transition, but. they’ll gain new moves, so you’ll. definitely notice. I later discovered. that flame-type artifacts provide. lifesteal, making the dual blades even. more satisfying to use, so I’d just. rush in and hack away. It’s not just. one type either; some grant lifesteal. once you hit five stacks of "Burning. Heaven," while others let you recover. HP just by standing in a fire ring on. the ground. I’m sure other builds. have their own powerful setups. I saw a. divinity skill that costs one bar of. energy, and another that refills a bar. five seconds after using a steam skill,. which seems like a great combo for. rapid ability spamming. I’ve only.

played with the dual blade setup,. mainly focusing on fire. If you have a. better understanding of what the. artifacts offer, you don't need to be. like me and just grab every fire item. you see. Targeting specific key stats. would be more efficient, since I. realized I couldn't really use some of. the fire attributes I picked up. What’s even more worth noting is that. at first, I didn't realize you couldn't. just equip two swords and swap between. them; you can’t do that. Since there. are also agility, adventure, and. battlefield talents to invest in, I. spent all my talent points on those. So. , even though the boss fights on screen. look fast-paced and fun, I actually. haven't unlocked almost any of the dual. blade talents. I believe investing in. those points would raise the. character's skill ceiling. I quite like. this kind of roguelite out-of-game. progression—it doesn't just force you. to stack damage, crit, or raw numbers,. but lets you gradually unlock the. character's potential and add new moves. and actions, which is pretty great. Of. course, there are some talents that. make a huge difference, like the fact. that I haven't even unlocked my second. relic slot yet. This shows that if you. have a good understanding of the game. and some proficiency with action games,. the game lets you progress at your own. pace. You don't necessarily need to. grind to a certain level to clear it; even if you die, taking your resources. out can significantly enhance your. experience. It improves the gameplay. experience and strengthens your. character. By the way, the game has. ultimate moves, but the demo only. unlocked one. The talent tree is also. quite basic, but it looks like there. should be three moves total, with some. auxiliary effects for those ultimates. down the line. Progression doesn't end. there. As you fight monsters and hunt. for loot, you'll encounter Spirit. Beasts. You can challenge them in-game; if you win, they give you shards,. allowing you to equip them in future. battles—each one acting like a unique. summon. Aside from the initial Wind. Spirit in the demo, I encountered two. others. However, the Wind Spirit’s. healing is so vital to me that I. haven't even tried using the other two. yet. Even if you don't defeat the.

Spirit Beast, you'll still receive. shards based on how much health you. depleted. By exploring and defeating. elite bosses, you obtain recipes and. resources for crafting gear. Some. weapons and accessories need to be made. here, and Spirit Beast shards are. refined here too. Even if you can't. always win, you can at least collect. some shards. It’s a thoughtful design. that ensures your effort isn't wasted. Moreover, challenging Spirit Beasts is. very rewarding. Even when preparing to. face a new boss to advance the story,. you won't feel the need to skip them. out of fear of losing health or. resources. The game excels in visuals,. system design, combat, and boss. mechanics. Since the "class" feel is. determined by dual weapons, I’m more. willing to experiment with different. playstyles because the investment cost. for each is halved. I started with a. sword and shield, but since I could. still use the sword, I was later. willing to try a sword paired with. dual-blade Spirit Beast shards. With. the ability to bring consumables and. resources in and out of runs, plus the. overall narrative and cutscenes, it. feels more like an Action RPG with. roguelike elements rather than just a. roguelike with a bit of story added. As. for the downsides, what currently feels. off is the combat; there are times when. special effects and smoke make it hard. to tell if I’ve taken damage. I. wonder if there’s a way to make that. clearer. Another issue is that the. exploration paths don't feel very. smooth, even though there is a genuine. sense of exploration. These paths might. relate to out-of-game materials or. progression that increases your. strength for the current run. They. aren't particularly easy to navigate. and tend to be interconnected. In a. room-to-room map design, we naturally. want to clear the entire map before. moving to the next floor. Since it's a. roguelike, you might end up fighting a. few extra battles, and all the winding. paths can make the pacing feel a bit. tedious. Overall, it’s quite fun, and. since the demo is free, I highly. recommend downloading it to give it a. try. If you like it, you can add it. directly to your wishlist, and now I'm. just looking forward to the game's. length and pricing. Alright, that's it.

for today's video. I'm Rice, see you. all later, bye-bye. Yeah.

《定海》是由傑仕登開發、發行的 3D 俯視角動作角色扮演 Roguelite，以「大禹治水」與《山海經》神話為故事背景，把高速動作戰鬥、雙武器系統、精準格擋／完美閃避，以及 Roguelite 隨機構築融合在一起。實際玩過 Demo 之後，戰鬥系統的完成度更是讓我有點意外。

目前 Demo 可以使用劍、雙刃、弓等武器，不同武器除了普攻、重擊、武技之外，還有彼此銜接的「換武」攻擊。再搭配水、火、雷、毒等不同屬性的法寶構築，玩到後面可以組出不少有趣的流派。

頭目戰也是這次 Demo 我很喜歡的部分。從《山海經》異獸到不同階段的招式變化，並不是單純血厚傷害高而已，實際打起來有一定難度，也真的需要熟悉招式、閃避與精準招架。這支影片就完整跟大家聊聊《定海》Demo 的故事背景、雙武器戰鬥、Roguelite 構築、局外成長、靈獸系統、頭目戰，以及目前試玩下來我覺得比較可惜的地方。

Demo 免費，有興趣的玩家可以直接下載試玩；喜歡的話也別忘了加入願望清單！

故事圍繞著大禹治水的神話傳說展開。主角為大禹的義子「羿」，因義父失蹤而隻身前往不周山尋找，途中因善心搭救精怪卻反遭兇獸偷襲而瀕死。命懸一線之際，炎帝舊部「玄龍」的殘魂現身，雙方達成以肉身換取尋找大禹並拯救蒼生的契約。玄龍隨後將羿的靈魂置入附近的異獸體內使其重生，並在斬殺兇獸後識破由九頭蛇怪「相柳」偽裝的天帝，展開一場驚險對決。擊敗序章頭目後，羿抵達主殿大廳，在此可遇見義母女媧與經營商販的妹妹，並展開裝備鍛造與天賦升級。

無縫切換的武器系統與多元連招

遊戲戰鬥的核心亮點在於雙武器無縫切換系統，玩家無需手動停頓切換，透過按鍵配置即可流暢施展雙手武器的連續技。試玩版中開放了劍、雙刀與弓，每種武器皆具備獨特的切換突進技；例如劍的切換攻擊能直接躍至敵人背後觸發高額背刺增傷，而雙刀的「亂舞」則具備強悍的霸體效果。雖然遊戲支援精準格擋，但並非強制依賴，玩家可依自身節奏選擇近戰防反或以遠距離弓箭謹慎消耗。

裝備配置與元素流派的深度構築

遊戲的進階核心在於戰鬥前的裝備搭配與局內的隨機詞條（神器）構築。玩家入場前可攜帶飾品，例如提供蒸氣能量自動回復並與「護身之風」回血技能完美契合的「靈脈飾品」，能大幅提升探險過程中的生存續航力。在闖關爬塔期間，玩家還能獲取水、火、毒、雷等元素附魔與特殊動作詞條，例如賦予雙刀在霸體狀態下額外 40% 的減傷效果，或是將劍氣外放化為遠程劍波。這些豐富的隨機組合讓每場戰鬥的構建策略與操作體驗都充滿層次感與深度。

The game revolves around. the myth of Yu the Great harnessing the. waters and the spirits of the Classic. of Mountains and Seas. On the road, you see a vicious. beast about to eat a wind-spirit. creature. As the protagonist, you. naturally save the creature. Seeing the. beast beg for mercy and act as if. it’s genuinely repentant moves you,. so you soften your heart and let it go,. forgetting that such beasts are. incapable of telling the truth. With. your life hanging by a thread, Xuan. Long, who served under the Yan Emperor,. was exiled after the battle between the. two clans and eventually met his end on. the battlefield. His shattered soul. gradually faded away over centuries of. despair, which is where the two of you. meet. Xuan Long offers to help with one. thing in exchange for your physical. body. while I'm at it—if I'm going to make. a deal, I'll go big." Yi’s soul. eventually coexists with Xuan Long's in. the body, until Yi slowly loses. consciousness. Later, moved by a sudden. sense of pity, Xuan Long tosses Yi’s. soul into the nearby wind-spirit. creature, and Yi is resurrected as an. extremely rare chicken. Xuanlong. casually killed a beast on Mount Buzhou. and sought out the Celestial Lord to. negotiate when he could return to work,. only to realize mid-conversation that. the Lord was actually Xiang Liu in. disguise—a nine-headed serpent. monster—leading to a thrilling boss. battle. After defeating the prologue. boss, we descended into the main hall,. where we can prepare our weapons,. accessories, and items, as well as. craft gear, purchase supplies, and. upgrade talents. I’m using her as the. cover image, so I have to mention her:. this is your godmother, Nüwa. She is. the mother of Qi, the king of the Xia. dynasty, and also the wife of Dayu, so. technically, you and Qi are godbrothers. . The cat next to her is her younger. sister, who runs a business. You can. buy items from her, and any illusory. treasures found while exploring the map. can be sold directly to her. The. game’s combat system is quite fun. We. start with the White Cloud Sword and. Mist Bow. The game offers five. different types of weapons—three. melee and two ranged—with the demo. currently featuring the sword, dual. blades, and the bow. You don't need to. manually switch weapons during combat; the XY buttons or left and right mouse. clicks correspond directly to your two. equipped weapons. Beyond basic attacks. with XY or follow-up attacks after. dodging, every weapon has its own. unique moveset, which expands as you. unlock more talents. No matter which. two weapons you pair together, there. are specific transition attacks for. swapping between them. I really like. the sword's swap attack because it lets. you jump directly behind the enemy. This is safer since enemy attacks are. directional, and some random talents. provide damage bonuses for backstabs,. making fights much faster. I mentioned. perfect parrying earlier, but it’s. not an essential mechanic you’re. forced to master. Every weapon has a. special martial art triggered by RB and.

LB, such as the sword's parry or the. dual blades '"Flurry," which has super. armor and deals high damage. When I. first started playing, I found it to be. a bit challenging. Generally,. rogue-lite action games don't have this. many moves or such a wide variety of. features; they usually focus the. randomness on skill builds. In this. game, there are so many moves available. from the start that it might take a few. extra runs to fully understand the. mechanics. Early on, I wasn't familiar. with enemy attack patterns or the. game's rhythm, so I chose to hack and. slash in melee while using parries. When I encountered situations I didn't. understand, I’d slowly pick them off. with my bow. I found this to be a very. effective learning strategy. Things. were going smoothly and I was pushing. through steadily, but I soon realized I. had underestimated the boss fights in*. Dinghai*. Let alone the bosses. currently available in the three seas,. even the elite boss fights while. climbing the tower aren't exactly easy. I felt that staying at a distance with. the bow went against my nature, and no. matter how I played it, I just couldn't. get it right. So, I switched to a. dual-blade setup, going in with X-Y-X-Y. combos, focusing on precision parries. and dodging, which felt much more. natural. In particular, the blade's " Sword Dance" move allows you to dodge. attacks while dealing high damage, and. the dash attack has great range and. strong hit detection. For encounters. needing a quick start, leading with a. dash attack is a simple, high-damage,. and low-cost opening. *Dinghai*has an. equipment system consisting of two. weapons, two accessories, and one piece. of clothing. I haven't seen any clothes. yet; they might be skins or a. mid-to-late game system. Your gear. affects your core gameplay and. playstyle. You can only equip two items. before entering a run, and you cannot. change them once you've started. For. example, the "Yoran Accessory" provides. one bar of steam energy and a boost to. skill damage, with a "Full Power" effect that increases damage by 25%when. your health is above 90%. I personally. prefer the "Spirit Vein Accessory" you. get at the start. It recovers one bar. of steam every 10 seconds during combat. . Since steam for skills doesn't.

regenerate automatically—and recovery. items on the map are random attributes. —it's a limited resource. Plus, I. like using the "Wind of Protection" skill, which costs two bars of steam. It deals damage in an area for six. seconds and restores 1%of your health. per second. Since I was taking damage. so often and getting tired of dying, I. figured if I recover one bar every 10. seconds, that means I can restore 6%of. my health every 20 seconds. If I need. to, I can just run in circles in a mob. room to stall for time while my energy. recovers. By playing it safe, I can. eventually manage to reach a boss with. full health. The equipment you bring in. determines your basic experience, even. though we might encounter many. different attribute choices as we climb. the tower. For example, the "Seeker" artifact lets you deal backstab damage. with all your attacks for 10 seconds. after a successful backstab. It works. great with the sword's jump attack,. which almost always triggers it. It’s. also very effective against bosses; since they’re so huge, it's easy to. hit their backs, and it can even imbue. your attacks with Frost, Fire, or. Lightning elements. If you get "Burning" or "Explosion," those are triggered by. the "Heaven-Burning Twin Blades." There. are even upgrades that change your. weapon's moveset, like turning sword. slashes into projectile sword beams. Since you equip your weapons before. entering the stage, the random. artifacts you find inside are also. tailored to your build. In the current. demo, you can already imagine several. viable builds. For example, the sword. and blade work well with water and fire. , while the Ebony Bow and Ebony Sword. both use poison, making them much more. synergistic when choosing your. artifacts. I find the selection process. quite fun because they use many. different ways to layer the gameplay. experience. While weapon movesets have.

some variety, they mainly fall into a. few types: basic combos, combo. finishers, charged heavy attacks,. exclusive weapon skills, and. weapon-swap attacks. The artifacts you. choose might target specific elemental. attacks. Or they might focus on a. specific elemental weapon or a. particular weapon-swap move; these. combinations make combat feel easier or. more satisfying. For example, I once. got a buff that grants 40%damage. reduction while in super armor; the. dual blade flurry becomes quite strong,. and since it now has damage reduction,. I use it much more often. These choices. make the combat flow much more. comfortably. I’ll start by showing a. clip of me playing an elite battle very. poorly. It feels a bit chaotic. I know. the boss only has those few moves, but. it lacks a sense of rhythm. Before you. fully grasp the patterns, it’s quite. a struggle and feels a bit difficult. The boss casts spells, runs away when. you try to close the distance, and. periodically releases suicide bugs to. harass you. There are also two annoying. mosquitoes in the distance that allow. you to perform parries. The boss design. is actually quite decent. The boss. battle in the demo actually performs. quite well with solid combat mechanics. and good impact. At first, I didn't. know why I couldn't land any parries,. but later, I don't know why, but I. could suddenly do them all. Actually, I. initially felt the hit detection wasn't. great, but now I think it’s pretty. solid. The combat isn't exactly simple; most bosses have a clear P2, and. possibly a P3. They might not always. have an obvious phase transition, but. they’ll gain new moves, so you’ll. definitely notice. I later discovered. that flame-type artifacts provide. lifesteal, making the dual blades even. more satisfying to use, so I’d just. rush in and hack away. It’s not just. one type either; some grant lifesteal. once you hit five stacks of "Burning. Heaven," while others let you recover. HP just by standing in a fire ring on. the ground. I’m sure other builds. have their own powerful setups. I saw a. divinity skill that costs one bar of. energy, and another that refills a bar. five seconds after using a steam skill,. which seems like a great combo for. rapid ability spamming. I’ve only.

played with the dual blade setup,. mainly focusing on fire. If you have a. better understanding of what the. artifacts offer, you don't need to be. like me and just grab every fire item. you see. Targeting specific key stats. would be more efficient, since I. realized I couldn't really use some of. the fire attributes I picked up. What’s even more worth noting is that. at first, I didn't realize you couldn't. just equip two swords and swap between. them; you can’t do that. Since there. are also agility, adventure, and. battlefield talents to invest in, I. spent all my talent points on those. So. , even though the boss fights on screen. look fast-paced and fun, I actually. haven't unlocked almost any of the dual. blade talents. I believe investing in. those points would raise the. character's skill ceiling. I quite like. this kind of roguelite out-of-game. progression—it doesn't just force you. to stack damage, crit, or raw numbers,. but lets you gradually unlock the. character's potential and add new moves. and actions, which is pretty great. Of. course, there are some talents that. make a huge difference, like the fact. that I haven't even unlocked my second. relic slot yet. This shows that if you. have a good understanding of the game. and some proficiency with action games,. the game lets you progress at your own. pace. You don't necessarily need to. grind to a certain level to clear it; even if you die, taking your resources. out can significantly enhance your. experience. It improves the gameplay. experience and strengthens your. character. By the way, the game has. ultimate moves, but the demo only. unlocked one. The talent tree is also. quite basic, but it looks like there. should be three moves total, with some. auxiliary effects for those ultimates. down the line. Progression doesn't end. there. As you fight monsters and hunt. for loot, you'll encounter Spirit. Beasts. You can challenge them in-game; if you win, they give you shards,. allowing you to equip them in future. battles—each one acting like a unique. summon. Aside from the initial Wind. Spirit in the demo, I encountered two. others. However, the Wind Spirit’s. healing is so vital to me that I. haven't even tried using the other two. yet. Even if you don't defeat the.

Spirit Beast, you'll still receive. shards based on how much health you. depleted. By exploring and defeating. elite bosses, you obtain recipes and. resources for crafting gear. Some. weapons and accessories need to be made. here, and Spirit Beast shards are. refined here too. Even if you can't. always win, you can at least collect. some shards. It’s a thoughtful design. that ensures your effort isn't wasted. Moreover, challenging Spirit Beasts is. very rewarding. Even when preparing to. face a new boss to advance the story,. you won't feel the need to skip them. out of fear of losing health or. resources. The game excels in visuals,. system design, combat, and boss. mechanics. Since the "class" feel is. determined by dual weapons, I’m more. willing to experiment with different. playstyles because the investment cost. for each is halved. I started with a. sword and shield, but since I could. still use the sword, I was later. willing to try a sword paired with. dual-blade Spirit Beast shards. With. the ability to bring consumables and. resources in and out of runs, plus the. overall narrative and cutscenes, it. feels more like an Action RPG with. roguelike elements rather than just a. roguelike with a bit of story added. As. for the downsides, what currently feels. off is the combat; there are times when. special effects and smoke make it hard. to tell if I’ve taken damage. I. wonder if there’s a way to make that. clearer. Another issue is that the. exploration paths don't feel very. smooth, even though there is a genuine. sense of exploration. Since it's a. roguelike, you might end up fighting a. few extra battles, and all the winding. paths can make the pacing feel a bit. tedious. Overall, it’s quite fun, and. since the demo is free, I highly. recommend downloading it to give it a. try. If you like it, you can add it. directly to your wishlist, and now I'm. just looking forward to the game's. length and pricing. Alright, that's it.

for today's video. I'm Rice, see you. all later, bye-bye. Yeah.

《定海》是由傑仕登開發、發行的 3D 俯視角動作角色扮演 Roguelite，以「大禹治水」與《山海經》神話為故事背景，把高速動作戰鬥、雙武器系統、精準格擋／完美閃避，以及 Roguelite 隨機構築融合在一起。實際玩過 Demo 之後，戰鬥系統的完成度更是讓我有點意外。

目前 Demo 可以使用劍、雙刃、弓等武器，不同武器除了普攻、重擊、武技之外，還有彼此銜接的「換武」攻擊。再搭配水、火、雷、毒等不同屬性的法寶構築，玩到後面可以組出不少有趣的流派。

頭目戰也是這次 Demo 我很喜歡的部分。從《山海經》異獸到不同階段的招式變化，並不是單純血厚傷害高而已，實際打起來有一定難度，也真的需要熟悉招式、閃避與精準招架。這支影片就完整跟大家聊聊《定海》Demo 的故事背景、雙武器戰鬥、Roguelite 構築、局外成長、靈獸系統、頭目戰，以及目前試玩下來我覺得比較可惜的地方。

《定海》是由傑仕登開發、發行的 3D 俯視角動作角色扮演 Roguelite，以「大禹治水」與《山海經》神話為故事背景，把高速動作戰鬥、雙武器系統、精準格擋／完美閃避，以及 Roguelite 隨機構築融合在一起。實際玩過 Demo 之後，戰鬥系統的完成度更是讓我有點意外。

目前 Demo 可以使用劍、雙刃、弓等武器，不同武器除了普攻、重擊、武技之外，還有彼此銜接的「換武」攻擊。再搭配水、火、雷、毒等不同屬性的法寶構築，玩到後面可以組出不少有趣的流派。

頭目戰也是這次 Demo 我很喜歡的部分。從《山海經》異獸到不同階段的招式變化，並不是單純血厚傷害高而已，實際打起來有一定難度，也真的需要熟悉招式、閃避與精準招架。這支影片就完整跟大家聊聊《定海》Demo 的故事背景、雙武器戰鬥、Roguelite 構築、局外成長、靈獸系統、頭目戰，以及目前試玩下來我覺得比較可惜的地方。
